# UnitForce Technologies (UFT)

> Inspired Innovations since 2003 — software, engineering, and talent solutions for global enterprises across India, the USA, and the UAE. ISO 9001:2015 certified.

UnitForce Technologies operates as five interconnected practices: AI, engineering, talent, software, and manufacturing.

## Pages
- [Home](https://uftech.com/): Overview of UFT's services, industries, and clients.
- [About](https://uftech.com/about): Company story, leadership, and values.
- [Services](https://uftech.com/services): AI, engineering, talent acquisition, software, and manufacturing services.
- [Careers](https://uftech.com/careers): Open roles and life at UFT.
- [Contact](https://uftech.com/contact): Office locations and ways to get in touch.
